current_detail: The current 75 x 150 mm two-PCB model keeps UI, all direct buttons, encoder, USB, an 8-bit 32-MHz i8080 display transmit path and the independent BT.656 camera receive path local to S3. Hub RP uses 46/48 GPIO with GPIO6 and GPIO47 reserved; rear RP uses 45/48 with three reserves. The exact 80-contact M1 map closes 25 live signals, fourteen 3V3_MAIN contacts, two AON contacts, twenty-five returns and fourteen NC reserves while staying below the 0.4-A contact rating at the 4.25-A step. Four 11-mm compression stops, anti-shear datums and independent PCB capture keep M1 electrical/alignment-only. The generated four-face mock-up puts each mirrored inner face directly below its exterior, renders all USB roles consistently, and audits every antenna silkscreen label against SMA/MMCX bodies, the installed FPV cable, U214, the display and mounting keep-outs. The sole current H1 blocker remains one AKK-controlled K331 production package with maximum XYZ, land pattern and packaging/soldering/reflow evidence; purchasing, KiCad and fabrication remain unauthorized.
